title: Sagalee Teessoo Gahe
intro: Sagaleen isaanii sodaa osoo hin taane abdiidhaan raafamee teessoo haqaatti namni ba’aa ta’e tokko dhiyaate. Dhimmichi kan dhuunfaa ture, ta’us murtoon isaa yeroon ni dhaga’ama, duudhaa cunqursaa tokko ni diiga. Lubbuun urjii bira darbee komiin ishee dhagahame kun eenyu ture?
clues: Dhimma arraba koo hidhe irratti haqa barbaadaa garaa ulfaataa qabadheen dhufe.
Iyyannaan koo ergamaa qofaaf hin turre; isa bira darbee, gara isa hundumaa dhaga’utti ol ba’e.
Jechoonni narratti dubbataman akka sansalata bara durii darbee ture.
Ulfina kootiif imimmaan koo fi loojikiidhaan falmeen sababeeffadhe.
Mul’anni tokko gadi bu’e, karaa durii callisee dhukkubbii koo beeksise.
Waa’ee abbaa manaa koo kan falme naan jedhu, maqaan koos boqonnaa na bilisa na baase waliin walfakkaata ta’e.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
